Setup.connect-wallet: Connect your wallet to setup your account
Setup.paragraph:
Use the button below to complete the setup process. This will result in two prompts from your wallet:
  1. Sign a message used to generate your Obsidian-specific pair of private keys. These keys allow you to securely use Obsidian without compromising the private keys of your connected wallet. You do not need to save these keys anywhere!
  2. Submit a transaction to save the corresponding public keys on-chain, so anyone can use them to send you stealth payments.
